title: Travel Protection Plans: Effect of Club Membership and Linked Bookings
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what a Travel Protection Plans policy is charged, and the plan's own rating decides everything else.

A club discount is applied to the rated premium after loadings and before the policy fee, and never to the policy fee itself.

Cover bought alongside an air booking or a vacation package is rated on the same declared trip cost as that booking, and the two are corrected together where the booking's price changes.

A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive: a policy bought under a corporate programme takes the programme's negotiated premium and no club discount on top.

Club points accrue on the premium actually paid, at the earn rate of the plan held, and never on the policy fee or on a returned premium.

## A clause no longer in force

The clause providing that "the club tier held on the issue date decides the discount applied to the premium" — the club tier held on the issue date — is **no longer in force**; which tier decides the discount, and what applies where the tier moved, are settled on the current basis for that charge and not by this note. Where the membership lapses between quotation and issue the discount is lost, and that remains the case.

The other clauses above stand as clauses in force, and the plan entries this note reads — the points earn rate, whether a travel concierge is included, the staffed hours of the assistance line and whether remote medical consultation is included — are valid as scheduled.

## Where in the premium a discount lands

The order matters to the figure. The discount lands on the rated premium after the loadings have been added and before the policy fee is added, so the loadings are inside what the discount acts on and the policy fee is outside it. The policy fee is never discounted.

Hypothetically, on a rated premium of 400.00 USD after loadings, with a policy fee of 15.00 USD, a discount of 10 per cent acts on the 400.00 USD alone, giving 360.00 USD, and the 15.00 USD fee is then added undiscounted, for 375.00 USD in all.

Points then accrue on the premium actually paid at the earn rate of the plan held, which on that example is the 360.00 USD and not the 15.00 USD fee; and where premium is afterwards returned, no points accrue on what is returned.

## Cover bought alongside another booking

Where the cover was bought alongside an air booking or a vacation package, the declared trip cost is the same figure as that booking's, and a change in the booking's price is a matter for both records rather than one.
